test_objective: If a Subscription does not define a timeInterval member, the notification shall be sent whenever an entity matches the query defined in the subscription. The notification message shall include all the subscribed Entities that changed and that match (as mandated by clauses 4.9 and 4.10) the query and geoquery conditions

test_cases.name: 046_06_01 Check that a notification is sent with all matching entities
test_cases.doc: only the subscribed Entities matching the query and watched attributes shall be included.
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: 'building-location-attribute.jsonld'
}
